title: Peer Scholarly Critique
description: AIL 606 textbook section connecting peer scholarly critique to peer-critique-and-disposition log (criterion-anchored critique points plus accept / modify / reject dispositions), reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.

learning_objectives.statement: Convert praise or preference into criterion-anchored, actionable peer critique using the element-problem-criterion frame
Respond to each critique point with a reasoned disposition (accept, modify, or reject), including at least one reasoned rejection
Verify an AI-drafted critique against the actual artifact before adopting any of its points
Use annotations, support requests, and revision notes to decide what help or design change should come next

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
